description:
Reach the next checkpoint in record time with our fastest and lightest gravel bike yet - a swift silhouette built with the speed of Seta Plus and the all-terrain comfort of Gravel TA.

When here to there is absolutely anywhere, Seta Gravel TC gives you the tools to perform at the highest level.

Seta Gravel TC smartly combines the front chassis of the Seta Plus with the rear triangle and front fork of the Gravel TA, all wrapped up with the sterling strength and comfort of Tri-Composite tubing.

From swooping singletrack to high-mountain hike-a-bike, Seta Gravel TC opens the map to a winning blend of race speed, control and all-conditions comfort.

Seta Gravel TC features a special edition of Tri-Composite carbon fibre infused with raw copper wires to present a timeless aesthetic and remind us of the importance of riding in harmony with the environment. Like regular TC, the frame’s metallic filaments reduce vibrations and localized mechanical stresses. In the event of an impact, they perform a double duty by supporting structural integrity by dampening potentially harmful resonant frequencies.

With its adapted fork geometry and widened rear stays, Seta Gravel TC is built to navigate the toughest terrain. And with 700c wheels with room for up to 48mm rubber, its versatility knows no bounds.

This special version of the Seta Gravel Tri-Composite is mounted with the proven 11-speed mechanical groupset from the GRX 800 series in limited-edition brushed and polished silver. Shimano presented a select number of these pieces to Sarto to celebrate and recognise our commitment to handmade craftsmanship.
